clue.text: Mole or distressed taupe — boys thinking originally

indicators.note: distressed means battered or roughed up, so these letters are knocked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the word thinking

explanation.surface: Someone muses about a mole, perhaps on a garment in a tired brownish shade, while boys are pondering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' scrambles TAUPE and BOYS together with T, the first letter of 'thinking', signalled by 'originally'.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dark mole on the face is traditionally called by this name, once even painted on for glamour.

clue.text: Balloons that will have minor problems carrying mass?

indicators.note: carrying means holding something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: blips are small temporary glitches or setbacks
m is the standard symbol for mass in physics

explanation.surface: A wry question about whether balloons are bound to run into small snags while hauling heavy loads.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrage balloons and small airships are both known by this name, a noun for floating craft.

clue.text: Early drink for actors in this?

parts.note: am marks the morning hours, before noon, so early in the day
a dram is a small measure of spirits, especially whisky

explanation.surface: A tease that performers take a nip early on in some unnamed activity.
explanation.walkthrough: AM-DRAM is British shorthand for amateur dramatics, local non-professional theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateur dramatics is the hobby theatre that unpaid local performers take part in.

clue.text: Spiritual tenant lends car out

indicators.note: out here means wrong or disordered, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A spiritual-minded renter generously lets others borrow a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something transcending ordinary physical experience is mystical, otherworldly, a synonym for spiritual.

clue.text: Way of communicating plan, surrounded by heroes in trouble

indicators.note: surrounded by means one piece is enclosed by the other
in trouble suggests the word heroes is thrown into disarray and rearranged

parts.note: a map is a plan or chart of an area

explanation.surface: A battle plan has to be signalled while beleaguered heroes are all around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges HEROES into SE...HORE, which surrounds MAP.
explanation.definitionFit: Signalling with flags held in set positions is a method of passing messages at a distance.

clue.text: Outstanding — nothing on flank

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O
a wing is the flank or side of an army or building

explanation.surface: A sports report: someone excellent, contributing nothing out on the wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' means not yet paid, not excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt still unpaid is outstanding, the sense of being due or in arrears.

clue.text: Saw new job at last for cleaner in theatre

indicators.note: new means made afresh, so the letters of saw are formed into a different order
at last picks the final letter of the word job

explanation.surface: Someone saw a fresh vacancy for a theatre cleaner at long last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' is the operating theatre, not the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A pad of absorbent material used in surgery to mop up blood or clean a wound.

clue.text: Calls that may follow wolf?

parts.note: a wolf whistle is the admiring call aimed at an attractive passer-by, so these shrill calls can come after the word wolf

explanation.surface: Seems to ask about cries trailing a wild animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrill high-pitched calls made through pursed lips, and wolf goes in front to make the admiring catcall.

clue.text: Level of interest when in lecture

indicators.note: in means the second piece is placed inside the first

parts.note: to berate is to lecture or scold someone
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Describes how engaged an audience feels during a talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interest' is money charged on loans, not attention.
explanation.definitionFit: The central bank sets a benchmark percentage for borrowing on which other lending charges are built.

clue.text: Scabs coming as result of blow-waves?

parts.note: a strike is a blow or hit
breakers are large waves crashing on the shore

explanation.surface: Seems to ask about scabs on the scalp from a hairdresser's blow-dry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scabs' are workers who cross picket lines, not crusts on a wound.
explanation.definitionFit: Scab is the insulting term for a worker who carries on during an industrial dispute.

clue.text: Country cousin diary's revealed

indicators.note: revealed says the letters are exposed within the words cousin diary's

explanation.surface: A rural relative's journal is opened up for all to read.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country cousin' reads as one phrase, but 'Country' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A large nation of South Asia, home to over a billion people.

clue.text: Claims principal volunteers will meet in south

parts.note: main means chief or principal
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force
taken as written
S is the compass abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: A head teacher insists volunteers will gather somewhere in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a point is to assert or insist on it, the verb sense of claims.

clue.text: Emphasises drama with drink

parts.note: a play is a piece of drama
to sup is to drink, in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: Someone stresses that theatre goes best with a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To highlight or stress a feature is to make much of it, an idiomatic phrasal verb.

clue.text: Brood on source of genuine sparkle

indicators.note: source of takes the opening letter of the word genuine

parts.note: a litter is a brood of young animals born together

explanation.surface: Someone dwells on where real brilliance comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brood' looks like a verb meaning ponder; it is a noun for a family of young.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny shining reflective flecks give a glittering, twinkling shine, the same as sparkle.

clue.text: Dirty trousers found here

definitions.meaning: unfair or unsporting, as with a foul punch in boxing
taken literally, the waist of a pair of trousers sits under the belt line

explanation.surface: Implies something grubby about where clothing is kept.
explanation.definitionFit: An unfair blow lands under the waist, so the phrase means unsporting or dirty.

clue.text: Start of novel call supporting championship

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means placed underneath the other piece

parts.note: a title is a championship won in sport
to page someone is to call them over a speaker system

explanation.surface: A tale's opening phone call props up a sporting contest.
explanation.definitionFit: The leaf at the front of a book bearing its name, author and publisher.

clue.text: Plead during hospital investigation for aerosol

indicators.note: during means held within the time of something, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a scan is an imaging test carried out in hospital
to pray is to plead or beg

explanation.surface: A patient begs while undergoing medical tests to get an aerosol.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressurised container that sprays paint or other liquid as a fine mist.

clue.text: Offers favouring models

parts.note: pro means in favour of
models pose for artists, so to model is to pose

explanation.surface: Offers that are biased towards fashion models.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward a plan or marriage suggestion is to offer it, the verb in third person.

clue.text: Excitement must follow for each, maybe

indicators.note: must follow means this piece comes after the one before it

parts.note: per means for each, as in 'per person'
an adventure is an exciting experience

explanation.surface: A rule that thrills should come after each individual, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning perhaps or by chance, found in older literary English.

clue.text: Tried hard, putting recipe in cooker

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: a stove is a cooker
R is an abbreviation for recipe, from Latin recipe, take, on prescriptions

explanation.surface: A cook made a big effort, putting the dish into the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense of strive: to struggle or make great efforts.

clue.text: Stop a car and set off

parts.note: RR is Rolls-Royce, the luxury car

indicators.note: off here means wrong or out of order, so the letters of set are shuffled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Instructions to halt a vehicle and then depart.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring something to a halt is to arrest its progress, a synonym for stop.

clue.text: Plants trees on a line

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after the piece that follows it

parts.note: pines are coniferous trees

explanation.surface: Someone sets out saplings in a straight row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plants' looks like a verb but is the noun definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Small mountain flowers grown in rock gardens are named for their high-altitude habitat.

clue.text: Fleeces family on board

indicators.note: on, as in on board a ship, means the family is placed inside the vessel

parts.note: on board means aboard a ship, and SS (steamship) is the crossword stand-in for the vessel
kin are one's family or relatives

explanation.surface: A family on a ship is cheated out of their money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is a crossword convention: put the piece inside SS (steamship).
explanation.definitionFit: To skin someone is slang for swindling them, the same as fleecing.

clue.text: Retired thespian — one who makes demands

parts.note: ex means former, no longer in the role
a thespian is an actor

explanation.surface: A former performer turns out to be very demanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who insists on payment or obedience; to exact is to demand.

clue.text: Country vicar undressed by person sharing lead role

parts.note: a co-star shares top billing with another performer

indicators.note: undressed strips the outer letters from the word vicar

explanation.surface: A rural clergyman is stripped by a fellow leading actor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country vicar' reads as one phrase; 'Country' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A Central American republic between Nicaragua and Panama.

clue.text: Suggest almost always accepting fine

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so one piece is placed inside the other
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'
OK means fine or all right

explanation.surface: Someone proposes that nearly everything should be fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims EVER to EVE, which takes in OK.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke a feeling or memory is to call it to mind, to suggest it.

clue.text: Issue turning around hospital grub

indicators.note: turning around means the word is read backwards

parts.note: issue means offspring, such as a son
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A problem arises over hospital food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' means offspring here, not a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British slang for food.

clue.text: Evaluation of fools dispatched to capture capital of Malta

parts.note: asses are fools

indicators.note: to capture means to hold the next piece inside

parts.note: sent means dispatched

indicators.note: capital of takes the opening letter of the word Malta

explanation.surface: Idiots are sent off to seize Valletta, Malta's capital, judging by the report.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' means the initial letter, not the city.
explanation.definitionFit: An appraisal or judgement of worth or quality, a synonym for evaluation.
